budget_items.what_was_recorded: Trash bag prices rise about 5.5% effective October 15 because disposal costs exceed bag sale revenue, with new per-roll prices.
budget_items.quote: effective wednesday, october 15, trash bag prices will increase by approximately 5.5% due to disposal costs exceeding bag sale revenues.

budget_items.topic: Article F, Public Access Cable Committee transfer
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A prior transfer approved at Annual Town Meeting may not be valid, and an additional PAC request would remain regardless.
budget_items.quote: a prior $31,271 transfer approved at annual town meeting remains valid, as the funds had not yet been certified as retained earnings

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A standalone appropriation for outside project estimators was proposed, but no dollar amount had been determined.
budget_items.quote: a dollar amount had not yet been determined.

budget_items.topic: Article I, special education reserve fund
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The reserve fund balance cannot exceed a share of annual net school spending, and future Town Meetings would appropriate money into it.
budget_items.quote: the total balance cannot exceed 2% of annual net school spending.

budget_items.topic: Article D, prior-year capital appropriation reallocation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article would reallocate old or cancelled capital appropriations to current needs such as a stormwater consultant and a possible school project overrun.
budget_items.quote: reallocate funds from old, completed, or cancelled capital appropriations to fund current project needs

budget_items.topic: Article E, Board of Assessors DOR project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: An RFP for the Board of Assessors Phase 1 DOR project drew no bidders; staff are exploring an in-house approach.
budget_items.quote: an rfp yielded no bidders; staff are exploring an in-house approach through a special temporary employee via the sap.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The 41D exemption amount was updated, reflecting a COLA increase.
budget_items.quote: the 41d exemption amount was updated to $1,029, reflecting a 2.9% cola increase.

budget_items.topic: Board of Assessors report, obsolescence discounts
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Functional and economic obsolescence discounts were reviewed and removed from properties lacking justification.
budget_items.quote: the functional and economic obsolescence discounts totaling $8,231 were reviewed and removed from properties lacking justification.

budget_items.topic: Board of Assessors report, FY2026 new growth
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY2026 growth report projects new growth across residential, commercial, industrial, and chapter land.
budget_items.quote: the fy2026 growth report projects new growth of $392,380 across residential, commercial, industrial, and chapter land.

budget_items.topic: School Committee, Chapter 70 article and paraprofessional funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: School Committee discussed an article on additional Chapter 70 funding, which was not advanced; two paraprofessional posts to be funded through the salary reserve.
budget_items.quote: two additional paraprofessionals were needed at the primary and turkey hill schools, to be funded through the salary reserve
